authority: cards_v4.json and rules_v4.json; original stable IDs retained

HT.relic_effect: 每战第一次实际支付生命后获得4格挡；不会回复生命。
HT.resources: 蝶引2结束阶段；血梅香强度1..3、剩余2次；低血≤50%

AR.name: 阿蕾奇诺
AR.relic_effect: 每战第一次吸收成熟勒令后获得3格挡；不额外生成生命之契。
AR.resources: 生命之契0..8；每敌一个勒令，至下次己方回合开始成熟

FR.name: 芙宁娜
FR.relic_effect: 每战第一次实际切换荒/芒形态后抽1牌；切回同形态不触发。
FR.resources: 气氛0..12，每生命事件最多3、每轮最多4；唯一宾客各最多3次

RD.name: 雷电将军
RD.relic_effect: 每战第一次成功支付能量的军令牌结算后获得2格挡；不额外回能。
RD.resources: 愿力0..6，全来源每回合最多增长2；雷眼3次/2结束阶段；一心3次/2结束阶段

scope.runtime: closed original-character package; not an STS2 runtime

common.generated_or_copied_external_cards: not automatically admitted; adapter audit required

HT.cash_bloom: consume remaining ledger; no extra tick; does not receive root or revelry bonus

AR.normal_bonus: B if B>=2 else 0, using pre-consumption B
AR.heal_gate: burst family only in combat; campsite outside combat unaffected

targeting.usher: highest live HP; stable formation tie-break
targeting.crabaletta: lowest live HP; stable formation tie-break

FR.guest_high_hp: before each action, if 2*hp>maximum: pay 1 HP and add 1 only to first live hit of that batch
FR.refresh: max(old,new); not additive; switching does not replenish
FR.inactive_side: paused; cannot attack/heal until correct mode
FR.revelry_bonus: min(4,floor(actual_spent_fanfare/3)), first live hit per batch

RD.refund_timing: next turn only; combined cap of all next-energy sources remains 2
RD.command_block_changes: 15 listed card IDs have immediate top-level Block reduced by 2 in data; no generic runtime tax

production_mapping.direct_damage: Actors.damage(..., fixed=false); root bonus added to first live hit base before shared Strength/Weak/Vulnerable rounding
production_mapping.derived_damage: Actors.damage(..., fixed=true), or the existing nonrecursive retaliation path for counter; still obey Block and actual HP loss
production_mapping.delayed_and_starting_relic_block: fixed=true; do not apply Dexterity/Frail twice
production_mapping.pay_hp: existing loseHp/HP-loss path; cannot be paid by Block
production_mapping.laboratory_integer_debuffs: diagnostics only; not production status definitions

order: remove source card, spend energy, pay mandatory HP
consume applicable root resource and reserve root first-hit bonus
apply effects in listed order; conditional branches read snapshot
apply hero post-card triggers in reference order
complete surviving post-root non-target effects, then victory/defeat
end phase: blossom -> active salon/singer -> surviving enemy actions -> discard/expire
turn start: expire old Block, grant next rewards, reset per-turn counters, mature marks, draw
adapter_constraints: Use production shared damage/block/status/target/RNG/UID queue semantics; do not replace the whole combat engine with this laboratory.

Production cleanse is frozen to removal of weak and frail only; retain vulnerable/poison/entangled/negative strength. Reference attack_down/block_down remain diagnostic counters and MUST NOT become live Weak/Frail arithmetic. The separate shared_contract.py tests define the exact production mapping.
Do not map a skill name to extra effects; follow exact DSL and role rules.
Actual zero healing/block is not a successful gain event; no phantom fanfare/trigger.
All root bonuses are first live hit once per physical play, not multiplied across hits or targets.
All cloned/generated external cards and public relic/potion interactions require production differential tests; do not silently delete Traveler pools to fit this closed test.
